headline: Shrirampps Q2 net profit more than doubles YoY
summary: Shrirampps reported a consolidated net profit of 216 million rupees in Q2, up from 86 million rupees in the same period last year, while revenue fell to 1.84 billion rupees from 2 billion rupees.

headline: Globe Civil Projects Q2FY27: Revenue up 30% YoY
summary: Globe Civil Projects reported a 30.6% YoY rise in standalone revenue to ₹1,147.5 million for Q2FY27, though net profit declined 36% QoQ.

headline: Biocon gets US FDA nod for breast cancer biosimilar
summary: Biocon Limited received U.S. FDA approval for Pebrilzo, a biosimilar to Perjeta for HER2-positive breast cancer. This marks its fifth oncology biosimilar in the US, with commercial launch expected in Q3 2028.

headline: Glenmark launches generic Axitinib in US
summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA launched authorized generic Axitinib tablets, targeting a market with $538.4 million annual sales.

headline: ABB India: Motilal Oswal upgrades to Buy
summary: Motilal Oswal upgrades ABB India to Buy with a target of ₹8,200, citing 56% YoY order inflow growth. HSBC maintains Reduce rating at ₹5,400 amid margin contraction.

headline: Goldman Sachs holds Neutral on Ashok Leyland, target ₹152
summary: Goldman Sachs maintains a Neutral rating on Ashok Leyland with a target price of ₹152. Q2 revenue and PAT were broadly in line with estimates, with revenue and EBITDA growing 39% and 16% YoY respectively.

headline: CLSA cuts Tata Motors target price to ₹369
summary: CLSA maintains Outperform on Tata Motors but cuts target price to ₹369. JLR Q2 EBIT margin fell 166 bps QoQ to 1.1%, with FY27 guidance cut to 2-3% EBIT margin.

headline: Kalpataru Projects secures new order worth ₹2,610 crore
summary: Kalpataru Projects International has secured a new order worth ₹2,610 crore, marking a significant contract win for the infrastructure company.

headline: Sun Pharma plans $4 billion loan to refinance Organon deal
summary: Sun Pharma plans a $4 billion loan with five banks to refinance part of the bridge financing arranged for its $11.75 billion acquisition of Organon.

headline: RBI flags microfinance pricing and recovery concerns
summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised concerns over pricing practices and recovery methods in microfinance, while rejecting demands to ease credit assessment norms for microfinance institutions.

headline: Texmaco Rail wins ₹362.85 crore wagon order
summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹362.85 crore order from IVC Logistics for the supply of 464 wagons, marking a significant contract win for the company.

headline: India eyes local gold mining to cut import reliance
summary: The government aims to boost domestic gold mining through improved geological data, incentives, and private sector participation to reduce India's dependence on gold imports.

headline: Finance Ministry eyes standard customs rules for BESS
summary: The Finance Ministry may establish standard customs rules for battery energy storage projects to reduce import duty and GST costs, currently estimated at approximately 31%.

headline: India 10-year bond yield eases to 7.2959%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield declined to 7.2959% from the previous close of 7.3079%, reflecting a marginal easing in sovereign borrowing costs.

headline: Tata Steel plans merger with Neelachal Ispat by FY27
summary: Tata Steel plans to finalize its merger with Neelachal Ispat Nigam Ltd by the end of FY27, aiming to enhance operations and business integration.

headline: Indian rupee opens at 94.2075 against the dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 94.2075 against the US dollar, compared to the previous close of 94.21, reflecting a marginal movement in the domestic currency.

headline: Dharti Proteins approves 1:1 bonus share allotment
summary: Dharti Proteins Limited approved the allotment of 75,000 bonus equity shares in a 1:1 ratio for non-promoter members. The record date was November 13, 2026.

headline: Max Healthcare shares flag large trade at ₹975.20
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,40,662 Max Healthcare shares at ₹975.20 on NSE, with a combined value of ₹23.47 crore. Not a confirmed exchange deal.

headline: HGS signs 3-year deal with Rackspace
summary: Hinduja Global Solutions enters three-year partnership with Rackspace Technology for global engineering and digital capabilities, enhancing AI infrastructure services.

headline: Mayank Cattle Food expands retail network in Gujarat
summary: Mayank Cattle Food Ltd signs MOUs to open 11 new retail stores in Gujarat, marking its strategic entry into the retail segment to enhance brand visibility and revenue streams.

headline: Brightcom Q2FY27: PAT up 13.7% YoY
summary: Brightcom Group reported a 13.70% YoY rise in Q2 PAT to ₹264.96 crore, with revenue growing 17.38% to ₹1,937.04 crore.

headline: AIA Engineering shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,50,259 AIA Engineering shares changing hands on BSE at ₹3,170.00, with a combined value of ₹47.63 crore.

headline: Kinetic Engineering Q2FY27 Results
summary: Kinetic Engineering reports 99% YoY consolidated revenue growth to ₹78.31 crore. Standalone PAT turns positive at ₹0.44 crore, reversing prior quarter loss.

headline: Aartech Solonics Q2FY27 results
summary: Aartech Solonics reports Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹1.24 lakh, down 13% YoY, despite revenue growth to ₹1,260.50 lakh.

headline: Nath Bio-Genes H1FY27 revenue up 13%, PAT down 18%
summary: Nath Bio-Genes reported a 13% YoY rise in H1FY27 revenue to ₹3,601 Mn. However, EBITDA fell 11% and PAT declined 18% due to margin compression and higher finance costs.

headline: Tata Power commissions 100.8 MW wind project
summary: Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited commissioned a 100.8 MW wind project in Maharashtra, adding to its 7.3 GW operational renewable capacity.

headline: SC upholds NCLAT ruling against Twinstar resolution plan
summary: The Supreme Court has upheld the NCLAT's decision to reject the resolution plan submitted by Twinstar, which was backed by Vedanta, in an insolvency matter.

headline: Cummins India flags rising raw material costs
summary: Cummins India says raw material costs continue to rise, while diesel generators remain the primary power backup product in its portfolio.

headline: Hero Cycles picks Capillary Tech for dealer loyalty
summary: Hero Cycles has selected Capillary Technologies to enhance loyalty programs for over 3,000 dealers, strengthening its dealer engagement network.

headline: Caliber Mining projects ₹2,500 crore revenue target
summary: Caliber Mining And Logistics projects revenue of ₹2,500 crore, EBITDA of ₹580-600 crore, and PAT of ₹205-210 crore in its financial projections.

headline: Kiran Kumar Jain M. sells 0.617% stake in Raj TV
summary: Kiran Kumar Jain M. disposed of 3,20,391 equity shares of Raj Television Network Ltd via open market sale on November 13, 2026, reducing his holding to 3.988%.

headline: Intellect wins three Euromoney awards
summary: Intellect Design Arena secured three 'World's Best' titles at the Euromoney Transaction Banking Awards 2026 for its eMACH.ai platform, marking the second consecutive year of triple recognition.

headline: East Buildtech Q2FY27: Loss narrows to ₹12.44 lakh
summary: East Buildtech reported a standalone net loss of ₹12.44 lakh for Q2FY27, narrowing significantly from ₹45.36 lakh in the year-ago quarter. Revenue remained marginal at ₹3.63 lakh.

headline: Pashupati Cotspin allots 23.67 crore bonus shares
summary: Pashupati Cotspin allotted 23.67 crore bonus equity shares in a 3:2 ratio on Nov 16, 2026. Paid-up capital rises to ₹39.46 crore.

headline: Gopal Snacks launches Cristos wafer promos
summary: Gopal Snacks introduces consumer schemes for its ₹10 Cristos wafers to boost volume in the high-margin segment, which grew 40% YoY to ₹58 crore.

headline: Pioneer Investcorp Q2FY27 results filed with BSE
summary: Pioneer Investcorp Limited filed its Q2FY27 standalone and consolidated financial results with BSE on November 16, 2026. The company announced the approval of unaudited results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Medi Assist appoints Aruna Vaidyanathan as CGCO
summary: Medi Assist Healthcare Services appoints former TCS Global Head Aruna Vaidyanathan as Chief Growth & Culture Officer to unify brand strategy and scale international operations.

headline: Purohit Construction posts ₹88.57 lakh loss in H1FY27
summary: Purohit Construction reported a net loss of ₹88.57 lakh for H1FY27, driven by a ₹69.45 lakh GST provision and zero revenue.

headline: Grandma Trading Q2FY27 loss narrows to ₹2.96 lakh
summary: Grandma Trading & Agencies reported a net loss of ₹2.96 lakh in Q2FY27, an improvement from ₹4.81 lakh loss in Q2FY26, despite revenue rising to ₹8.87 lakh.

headline: MCL IPO: OFS of 66.18 Cr Shares
summary: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd files DRHP for pure Offer for Sale of 66.18 crore shares by Coal India. India's largest single coal producer lists Nov 27, 2026.

headline: Polycab India to host investor meets on Nov 20
summary: Polycab India Limited will conduct one-on-one meetings with GIC and BNP Paribas on November 20, 2026. The sessions will be virtual and in-person, sharing publicly available data.

headline: Fruition Venture Q2FY27 Results: Loss widens to ₹6.58 lakh
summary: Fruition Venture reported a standalone net loss of ₹6.58 lakh in Q2FY27, a sharp swing from ₹2.54 lakh profit YoY. Revenue rose 3.1% YoY to ₹104.14 lakh.

headline: Laurus Labs promoter sells small stake for charity
summary: A Laurus Labs promoter has sold a small stake for charitable purposes. The company clarified that this transaction does not affect its business outlook or operations.

headline: Navin Fluorine shares flag large trade on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 50,497 shares of Navin Fluorine International at ₹9,975.50 per share on NSE, with a combined value of ₹50.37 crore.

headline: Ashok Leyland raises M&HCV volume growth forecast
summary: Ashok Leyland has raised its M&HCV segment volume growth forecast and expects domestic CV industry growth to be in the double-digit to mid-teen range for FY27.

headline: IFGL Refractories opens tap hole clay plant
summary: IFGL Refractories has opened a new manufacturing plant for tap hole clay with an investment of GBP 172,000, targeting GBP 2 million in annual revenue at full capacity.

headline: PTC Industries H1FY27 PAT jumps 168% YoY
summary: PTC Industries reported a 168.2% YoY rise in PAT for H1FY27, driven by strong aerospace and defence execution. EBITDA margins expanded to 27.1%.

headline: UTI AMC to host Centrum Broking meeting Nov 27
summary: UTI Asset Management Company Limited will hold a one-on-one analyst meeting with Centrum Broking Limited on November 27, 2026, in Mumbai.

headline: Ashok Leyland auditors flag discrepancies
summary: Statutory auditors identified discrepancies in transactions with Hinduja Leyland Finance. The company also plans to decide on cell manufacturing in FY28.

headline: Dove Soft seeks shareholder nod to raise authorised capital to ₹50 crore
summary: Dove Soft Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking member approval to increase its authorised share capital from ₹35 crore to ₹50 crore. The proposal aims to facilitate future business expansion and fund-raising activities.

headline: UTI AMC to host Alpha Alternatives meet on Nov 20
summary: UTI Asset Management Company Limited will hold a one-on-one meeting with Alpha Alternatives on November 20, 2026, in Mumbai. No UPSI will be shared.

headline: Coal India moves into renewable energy sector
summary: DIPAM Secretary has stated that Coal India is moving into the renewable energy sector, signalling a strategic diversification for the state-owned mining giant.

headline: Amagi Media Labs to host CLSA investor meet Nov 19
summary: Amagi Media Labs Limited announced a group meeting with institutional investors and analysts organized by CLSA on November 19, 2026, in Bengaluru.

headline: Safety Controls & Devices H1FY27 Results
summary: Safety Controls & Devices reported 33.4% revenue growth and 36.9% net profit rise in H1 FY27, with total borrowings declining 40.6%.

headline: Winsome Breweries Q2FY27 PAT up 64% to ₹14.74 lakh
summary: Winsome Breweries reported a 64% YoY rise in net profit for Q2FY27, driven by strong other income despite operational losses. Revenue from operations fell slightly.

headline: Onix Solar promoter pledges 10.24% stake
summary: Onix Renewable Limited pledged 37,75,000 shares of Onix Solar Energy to Transrail Lighting for working capital needs.

headline: Future Consumer MD Samson Samuel exits after tenure
summary: Samson Charuvil Samuel ceased as Managing Director of Future Consumer on Nov 4, 2026, due to tenure expiry. The company is currently undergoing insolvency proceedings.

headline: Canara HSBC Life Insurance promotes Indu Swaroop as CFO
summary: Canara HSBC Life Insurance has promoted Indu Swaroop to the position of Chief Financial Officer, marking a key leadership change at the company.

headline: MV Electrosystems secures order worth ₹325 crore
summary: MV Electrosystems has secured a new order valued at ₹325 crore, marking a significant business development for the company.

headline: Anka India completes Futech merger
summary: Anka India Limited has completed the amalgamation of Futech Internet Private Limited, effective April 1, 2025. Authorized share capital increased to ₹52.01 crore.

headline: RR Financial Q2FY27 PAT rises 0.3% to ₹282 lakh
summary: RR Financial Consultants reported a marginal rise in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27. Revenue grew 8.6% YoY, while standalone profits surged significantly.

headline: Filatex India delays expansion; targets 25% EBITDA
summary: Filatex India delays expansion projects to Q4. The company expects EBITDA margins to reach about 25% for FY27.

headline: Paisalo Digital redeems NCDs on Nov 16, 2026
summary: Paisalo Digital Limited fully redeemed its 9.95% Listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures on November 16, 2026, as per regulatory filings.

headline: ISOC concludes postal ballot for MD pay, RPT
summary: Inter State Oil Carrier Ltd concluded its postal ballot voting period on November 15, 2026. Shareholders voted on revising Managing Director Sanjay Jain's remuneration and approving related party transactions.

headline: Bodhi Tree Q2FY27 income up 61% to ₹39.19 cr
summary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia reported a 60.6% YoY rise in total income to ₹39.19 crore for Q2FY27. EBITDA grew 40.5% YoY, while PAT surged 369% QoQ to ₹3.68 crore.

headline: Phoenix Intl Q2FY27 PAT up 26% to ₹127 lakh
summary: Phoenix International Ltd reported a 26% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹127.47 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by 10% revenue growth.
